systems.system: Integrated Public Safety Communication and Surveillance System (IPSCSS)
systems.platform: Built by Safaricom, with Huawei, under a May 2014 contract expected to cost KES 14.9 billion (US$169.6 million)
systems.tiers: 1,800 CCTV cameras with face and number-plate recognition in Nairobi and Mombasa, and a command and control centre; the same contract was to connect 195 police stations with high-speed internet, build a 4G LTE police network of 80 base stations, supply 7,600 radio devices and link 600 police vehicles to the centre

systems.platform: Installed and integrated by Nanjing Les Information Technology
systems.tiers: 42 cameras in the Nairobi Central Business District, due for completion by September 2013, under a US$100 million Chinese grant of 2012 meant for major cities and towns starting with Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu

note: The document describes camera and command-centre projects, of class surveillance, and police connectivity and radios, which are enabling; it states nothing about a system in which stations record reports or cases.
